workflow: A sequence comparison obtains borrowed references to operand elements for a later comparison.
A user-defined comparison callback runs reentrantly and mutates one operand, releasing or removing those elements.
The comparison resumes and uses the previously borrowed references without keeping the referenced objects alive.
The access reaches freed element storage, causing a use-after-free crash instead of returning a comparison result or recoverable error.
summary: Reentrant operand mutation invalidates borrowed comparison elements
